name: Ampeg SVT 1969
description: Ampeg Super Valve Technology, catalogue 54000. POWER SECTION from the 1969 6146B sheet (Joe Piazza): input 1K + 1K with 470K and antiparallel clamp diodes into a 12DW7 (220K plate, 2.2K + 220 cathode with the global feedback 47K || 120 pF into the 220), a 12DW7 cathodyne (15K plate, 1K + 10K + 15K Balance cathode), two 12BH7 drivers (47K 5 W, 1.8K), and per bank a .047 uF / 150K / 150K drive node with the 22K - 15K lin - 39K bias divider into a 12BH7 cathode follower that drives three 6146B/8298A grids through 47K each; 22 ohm 1 W screen and 10 ohm 5 W plate resistors, one 1 ohm 1 W cathode sense per bank (K1/K2), O.T. 8950004 into a 4 ohm load (32 ohm x 8). Supply: P.T. 8930007 as a multi-winding transformer into a four-diode bridge, 100 uF/450 V over 70 uF/450 V || 40 uF/450 V with a 220K 2 W across each half, 8.2K 15 W to the 30 uF/600 V driver rail, 15K 1 W to the 40 uF/450 V V1 rail, 8.2K 2 W to the preamp's 40 uF/400 V rail; screen rail 200 uF/250 V, negative bias rail 90 uF/200 V; F.T. 8930008 for the 6.3 V heaters with the 100 ohm hum-balance pot. PREAMP from the 1972 preamp sheet (Joe Piazza) - DISCLOSED: no 1969 preamp drawing was found in any source reachable here, and early SVTs had several preamp revisions. Channel One (12DW7, Bass Select / Ultra-Low group, Bass/Treble 1 M stack) and Channel Two (12AX7, Ultra-Low / Ultra-High bank, Bass/Treble 1 M stack) are transcribed; the preamp's V3/V4 12DW7 and V5 6C4 cathode-follower stages, the 320821-1 mid inductor and the Mid-Range Select are not modelled (see notes).

io.note: outputVoltsPerFS = 1.5 x the 57.7 V peak measured at the speaker dimed (volume, bass, treble 1; a 0.35 FS peak DI, 88.2 kHz, settled start; sines at 41-1000 Hz, 0.03-0.3 V gave 47-56 V). 300 W into 4 ohm is 49 V peak, so the power stage clips at its rating and the feedback holds it symmetric. At the catalogue defaults the same DIs peak at 50-53 V (-4.3 dBFS), and the unit test's 0.1 V / 220 Hz sine reads 23.7 V rms (0.27 FS rms). 87 -> 66.82 (2026-11-11, control audit): the Ultra-Lo/Ultra-Hi rewire puts the drawn .001 uF || 10M coupling in Channel Two with Ultra Lo off (the catalogue default), which lowered the DI level by 2.29 dB (3 s riff, 0.5 V peak, unit defaults); the scale keeps the shipped level.

parts.label: 120 V 60 Hz mains (169.7 V peak, starting at the crest)
P.T. 8930007 (multi-winding power transformer)
parts.note: ALL WINDING DATA IS FITTED and disclosed - the drawing gives part numbers and rail voltages, never turns or DCR. 1:4.856 for the HT lands the settled rail on the sheet's 690 V; the bias halves at 1.069 give the ~-160 V that the drawn 22K / 15K lin / 39K divider and the 12BH7 cathode followers turn into about -48 V at the 6146B grids (24.4 mA per valve, the datasheet's point A) with the Bias trimmers centred (the 90 uF/200 V on that rail allows it); the 1.3316-per-half screen winding lands the screen rail on the datasheet's 200 V (its 200 uF/250 V cap is what pins the screen rail's voltage). DCR 2 ohm primary, 32 ohm HT, 40 ohm per bias half and 12 ohm per screen half are typical-PT values; leakages 8/128/4/4/4/4 mH, lm 40 H and lsat 4 are fitted to the settled rails, not to lab data.

DC stand-in for the preamp's unmodelled V3/V4 12DW7 and V5 6C4 stages
parts.note: not a drawn part: the preamp sheet's V3 (47K/1.5K and 220K/560+7.5K), V4 (470K/3.3K and a DC-coupled follower into 47K+6.8K with 56K to V3's cathode) and V5 6C4 follower (1K+47K) are not in the audio path, but they load the 8.2K 2 W rail. Solved at DC with this netlist's 12DW7 cards they draw 16.0 mA at 350 V and 18.4 mA at 400 V (14.7 / 16.9 mA with the library 12AX7/12AU7 cards): 22K to chassis within 3 % over 300-400 V. Without it the preamp rail sits above its 40 uF/400 V cap.

1N4007.note: 1N4007 silicon rectifier (the SVT bridge and the bias rectifier are solid-state)

12DW7_B.note: 12DW7 section 2 = a 12AU7 section (mu 17); the engine's 12AU7 card is mu 21.5, this is the datasheet 17

12BH7.note: 12BH7A, Koren form FITTED to the RCA datasheet's class-A1 point: mu 16.5 (sheet), ex 1.3 and kvb 300 (the library 12AU7 values), kp 202 and kg1 1302 solved so 250 V / -10.5 V gives 11.5 mA and 3.1 mA/V (sheet 11.5 mA, 3100 umho; rp 5.28k, sheet 5.3k). Caps: RCA data.

6146B.note: 6146B/8298A beam pentode, FITTED to the RCA datasheet. mu 4.5 is the datasheet's grid-2 to grid-1 amplification factor. kvb 45 is the plate knee from the Eb/Ib curves (the datasheet's two operating points do not constrain it) and ex 1.35 is the library pentode value; kg1 and kp are then solved so point A (600 V, -47 V, Vg2 200 V -> 24 mA/tube) and the gm anchor (7 mA/V at 200 V, -12 V, Vg2 200 V) are exact, and point B (750 V, -48 V -> 23 mA/tube) comes out -3.5 % low. kg2 12000 gives 2.3 mA/tube idle screen current; the datasheet gives only the max-signal figure (14.8 mA per pair) so kg2 is not fitted.
